shared_elements: low-relief carving on a flat stone panel
a scene occupying a horizontal band across the field
spoked wheel / circular disc with radiating spokes
linear rendering of rigging/reins as long straight lines
repeated vertical hatched or striped elements (sail grid / chariot and figures)
justification: The only concrete correspondence is a circular disc divided by spokes (the ship's shield-like circle or a chariot wheel) and the use of long straight lines (rigging versus reins) crossing the field, both rendered in shallow linear relief; these are generic and easily arrived at independently. A depicts a single symmetrical ship with mast, gridded sail and hull with a row of triangles, while B depicts a narrative scene of horses, a chariot and human archers with weapons in dynamic profile motion — different subjects, relationships and conventions of depiction.
